settings.heading: Overnight, your glass turns to stone.
settings.text: At −12°C, moisture freezes into a hard crust on the windshield, side windows and mirrors. Every morning starts with a scraper.

settings.heading: Lay it on. Tuck it in. Done.
settings.text: Spread Frostveil over the windshield, slip the elastic pockets over your mirrors and close the doors on the side flaps. It locks in place — no tools, no clips.

settings.heading: Snow lands on the cover. Not on your car.
settings.text: The nano-coated outer layer sheds water and snow, the Oxford core isolates the cold, and the non-slip PVC backing stays put on the glass.

settings.heading: Peel. Shake. Drive.
settings.text: Open the door, pull the cover away and the ice goes with it. Clear windshield, clear side glass, clear mirrors.

settings.heading: It blocks the sun, too.
settings.text: Flip the season — the same cover shields your dashboard from UV and heat, so the cabin and steering wheel stay cooler in the parking lot.

settings.a: Frostveil is designed to fit most hatchbacks, sedans, SUVs and MPVs. Choose Standard for cars and hatchbacks and XL for SUVs, MPVs and vans. If you're between sizes, choose XL — extra overlap is better than too little.

settings.q: How does it stay on in the wind?
settings.a: The side flaps tuck inside the front doors and are held when you close them, and the elastic mirror pockets anchor both sides. The non-slip PVC backing keeps it from sliding on the glass.
With the flaps shut inside locked doors, the cover can't simply be lifted off the car.

settings.q: Will it scratch my windshield or paint?
settings.a: No. The inner layer is a soft PVC that sits gently on glass. Make sure the glass is free of grit before laying it on.

settings.q: What if snow freezes onto the cover?
settings.a: Pull it off and give it a shake — the nano-coated surface stops ice from bonding strongly. Let it dry before folding it away.

settings.q: Can I use it in summer?
settings.a: Yes. The outer layer reflects sunlight and UV, helping keep your dashboard and steering wheel cooler when parked.

settings.q: Can I put it on a wet or frosted windshield?
settings.a: Yes. It's waterproof. For best results, install it the evening before frost is forecast.
Rinse with water or wipe with a damp cloth and mild soap, then air dry. Don't machine wash or tumble dry.
